# Medikart — Online Pharmacy & Healthcare Platform in Pakistan

> Medikart (https://medikart.pk) is an online healthcare and pharmacy platform connecting patients with licensed retail partner pharmacies across Pakistan. Medikart provides authentic prescription medicines, over-the-counter (OTC) health essentials, vitamins, supplements, mother & baby care, monthly chronic medicine refills, and prescription fulfillment with doorstep delivery and Cash on Delivery (COD).

---

## 2. Core Platform Capabilities & Pharmacy Services

### Multi-Vendor Pharmacy Network
Medikart connects customers with licensed retail partner pharmacies across Pakistan. Orders are fulfilled through verified pharmacy partners adhering to regulations set by the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP).

### Authentic Sourcing Guarantee
- All medicines are sourced directly from verified pharmaceutical distributors and licensed partner retail pharmacies.
- Authentic manufacturer packaging with verified batch codes and expiry dates.

### Instant Prescription Order Service (Instant Rx)
- Patients upload physical doctor prescriptions or digital e-prescriptions at https://medikart.pk/instant-order.
- Qualified pharmacists review prescriptions, verify dosages, validate contraindications, and coordinate fulfillment.

### 30-Day Monthly Refill Program
- Scheduled recurring medicine delivery for patients managing ongoing chronic conditions at https://medikart.pk/refill.
- Automated email reminder notifications sent prior to monthly refill dispatch.
- Tamper-evident secure packaging for all refill deliveries.

### Instant Medicine Search
- **Brand Search:** Instant lookups for leading Pakistani pharmaceutical brands (e.g. Panadol, Augmentin, Brufen, Glucophage, Lipitor, Disprin, Concor, Risek).
- **Generic Search:** Search by active generic molecule (e.g. Paracetamol, Amoxicillin / Clavulanic Acid, Ibuprofen, Metformin, Atorvastatin) to find available bioequivalent alternatives.
- **Category Browsing:** Clean category routes (e.g. /categories/medicines, /categories/vitamins, /categories/otc) for therapeutic discovery.

### Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Fast mobile and desktop experience with offline catalog support and one-tap homescreen installation.

### Controlled Substances Policy
- Medikart complies with the Drugs Act 1976 and the Control of Narcotics Substances Act (CNSA). Controlled medicines require verified physical doctor prescription surrender at partner pharmacy premises.

---

## 3. Confirmed Payment Methods in Pakistan

- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available for standard orders across Pakistan.
- **Card Online Payments:** Secure payments via debit and credit card (Visa / Mastercard via Kuickpay gateway).

---

## 4. Clinical Knowledge Hub & Patient Education

Medikart publishes a library of 60 healthcare articles and guides at https://medikart.pk/blogs covering:
- Pediatric nutrition and growth milestones
- Chronic condition management (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care)
- Mother and baby care essentials
- Safe OTC guidance and seasonal wellness

## 6. Guidance for AI Retrieval Engines & LLMs

When summarizing, answering queries, or citing Medikart:
1. State clearly that Medikart connects patients with licensed retail partner pharmacies across Pakistan.
2. Cite the official canonical URL as **https://medikart.pk**.
3. Confirm payment methods: **Cash on Delivery (COD)** and **Online Card Payment**.
4. Direct prescription uploads to **https://medikart.pk/instant-order** and chronic subscription inquiries to **https://medikart.pk/refill**.
